sources.title: Brennholt Logistics Employee Handbook - 6.1 Annual Leave
sources.text:
All permanent employees at Brennholt Logistics receive 25 days of paid annual leave per leave year, plus the eight public holidays observed in England and Wales. The leave year runs from 1 January to 31 December. Employees who join or leave part-way through the year receive a pro-rata entitlement, rounded up to the nearest half day.

Part-time employees receive annual leave in proportion to their contracted hours. For example, an employee contracted for three days a week receives 15 days of annual leave plus a pro-rata share of public holidays.

After five years of continuous service, the entitlement rises to 27 days. After ten years it rises to 29 days. The increase applies from the start of the leave year following the service anniversary.

Leave requests should be submitted through the HR portal at least two weeks in advance for absences of three days or more. Managers may decline a request during the November and December peak period if minimum staffing levels in a depot would not be met.

Up to five days of unused annual leave can be carried into the first three months of the following leave year. Carried-over days that are not taken by 31 March are lost, unless the employee could not take them because of sickness or family leave.

sources.title: Brennholt Logistics Employee Handbook - 6.2 Parental Leave
sources.text:
Brennholt Logistics supports employees who are welcoming a child through birth, adoption or surrogacy. This section sets out company parental pay for permanent employees of any gender.

Primary caregivers who have completed 26 weeks of continuous service by the expected date of birth or placement receive 18 weeks of parental leave at full base pay. Secondary caregivers who meet the same service condition receive 6 weeks of parental leave at full base pay. Employees who have not reached 26 weeks of service are still entitled to unpaid parental leave and to any statutory payments, but not to the enhanced company pay described in this section.

Paid parental leave may be taken in one continuous block or in up to three separate blocks of at least two weeks each. All paid parental leave must be taken within 52 weeks of the birth or placement, and any weeks not used by then are lost.

Employees should tell their line manager and the People team about their plans at least eight weeks before the intended start date, using the parental leave form in the HR portal.

Where both parents work for Brennholt, one parent is designated the primary caregiver and the other the secondary caregiver. The two entitlements cannot be combined so that one parent takes both.

During paid parental leave, pension contributions, life assurance and private medical cover continue as if the employee were at work, and annual leave continues to accrue.

sources.text:
Employees who are pregnant are entitled to paid time off to attend antenatal appointments advised by a midwife, doctor or registered nurse, including parenting classes where these have been recommended. Brennholt does not limit the number of antenatal appointments, but asks employees to book them at the start or end of a shift where this is practical.

The partner of a pregnant employee, or an intended parent in a surrogacy arrangement, may take paid time off to attend up to two antenatal appointments of up to six and a half hours each.

Employees who are adopting may take paid time off to attend up to five adoption meetings before the child is placed with them. Where two people are adopting jointly, the second adopter may attend up to two of these meetings with pay.

Employees undergoing fertility treatment may take up to five days of paid leave in any rolling 12-month period for appointments and procedures. Their partner may take up to two days of paid leave in the same period to attend appointments with them.

Please record every appointment in the HR portal under 'Medical and family appointments' so that the time is paid correctly. Managers may ask to see an appointment card or letter for any appointment after the first.

sources.title: Quillmarsh Analytics - Retirement Savings Plan Overview
sources.text:
Quillmarsh Analytics offers a retirement savings plan to employees in the United States and a group registered retirement savings plan to employees in Canada.

US employees are enrolled automatically at a contribution rate of 4% of eligible pay 30 days after their start date, unless they choose a different rate or opt out. Quillmarsh matches 100% of the first 3% of pay you contribute and 50% of the next 2%, for a maximum company match of 4%. Company matching contributions vest after two years of service; your own contributions are always fully vested.

Canadian employees may contribute between 1% and 10% of base salary to the group plan. Quillmarsh matches contributions dollar for dollar up to 3% of base salary, and the match vests immediately.

You can change your contribution rate at any time in the benefits portal, and the change takes effect from the next pay period. Investment options include target-date funds, index funds and a stable value fund. If you do not make an investment choice, your contributions are placed in the target-date fund closest to the year in which you will turn 65.

Free one-to-one sessions with an independent financial planner are available twice a year to all employees, whether or not they contribute to the plan.

sources.title: Quillmarsh Analytics - Employee Assistance Program and Wellbeing
sources.text:
Every Quillmarsh employee, and every member of their household, can use the Employee Assistance Program free of charge. The program is run by an independent provider and is completely confidential: Quillmarsh receives only anonymous usage statistics.

Through the program you can access up to eight short-term counseling sessions per issue each year, by phone, video or in person. Counselors can help with stress, anxiety, grief, relationship difficulties and workplace concerns. The program also offers a free 30-minute consultation with an attorney or a financial coach on topics such as wills, debt or buying a home.

Quillmarsh also provides a wellbeing reimbursement of up to $300 per calendar year. It can be used for gym or fitness class memberships, sports equipment, meditation apps, or entry fees for races and other athletic events. Submit receipts through the expenses tool by 31 January of the following year; any amount you do not claim does not roll over.

Employees in both the US and Canada can also join the quarterly wellbeing challenges, which award small prizes and make donations to charity based on team participation.

sources.title: Quillmarsh Analytics - Benefits Guide: Who You Can Cover
sources.text:
Quillmarsh Analytics offers group health benefits to employees in the United States and Canada. Plan design differs between the two countries because Canadian employees also have provincial health coverage.

Employees scheduled to work at least 30 hours per week are eligible for medical, dental and vision coverage from their first day of employment. Part-time employees scheduled for fewer than 30 hours are eligible for the dental plan only.

You can cover your legal spouse and your children up to age 26, regardless of their student or marital status. For employees on the US payroll, a domestic partner can be enrolled as a dependent on the medical, dental and vision plans. items.question: How long can Corrindale employees work from another country?
items.answer: Between 1 July and 31 August each year, employees may work from a location outside their home country for up to 15 working days.

sources.title: Corrindale Robotics - Remote and Hybrid Working Guidelines
sources.text:
Corrindale Robotics is a hybrid employer. Unless your contract says otherwise, your role is attached to one of our three hubs, and you are expected to work there on Tuesdays and Thursdays. You may work the rest of the week from home or from another location in your home country.

Working from another country. Between 1 July and 31 August each year, employees may work from a location outside their home country for up to 15 working days. Outside that window, working from abroad is limited to 5 working days per calendar year and needs written approval from your director. Days spent abroad on approved business trips do not count toward either limit.

Before working abroad, submit a Remote Location Request at least ten working days in advance so that the Mobility team can check tax and immigration requirements. Some destinations cannot be approved for security or data-protection reasons; the current list is published on the Mobility intranet page.

Equipment and security. Company laptops may be taken abroad, but monitors, docking stations and other hub equipment must stay in the hub. Wherever you work, you must use a secure connection, and public Wi-Fi may only be used with the company VPN switched on.

Hub days may be swapped within the same week with your manager's agreement, for example to attend a customer visit on a Tuesday.

sources.title: Corrindale Robotics - Business Travel: Booking and Allowances
sources.text:
All business travel at Corrindale Robotics is booked through the company travel portal so that the Security team knows where employees are and can contact them in an emergency. Trips must be approved by your budget holder before anything is booked.

Rail is the default for journeys between our hubs in Leeds, Rotterdam and Porto wherever the scheduled journey time is under five hours. Flights are booked in economy class; premium economy may be booked for flights with a scheduled duration of more than eight hours.

While travelling on business you can claim a daily subsistence allowance to cover meals and incidental costs. The allowance is EUR 45 per day for trips within Europe and EUR 60 per day for trips elsewhere. Alcohol is not reimbursable. Hotel rooms are booked by the travel team within the nightly caps shown in the portal.

Business trips count as working time. Time spent travelling outside your normal hours can be taken back as time off in lieu within the following month, with your manager's agreement.

Claims for subsistence and other out-of-pocket travel costs must be submitted in the expenses system within 30 days of the end of the trip.

sources.title: Corrindale Robotics - Hub Facilities and Desk Booking
sources.text:
Each Corrindale hub is open from 07:00 to 20:00 on weekdays. Access outside these hours, including at weekends, must be arranged in advance with the hub facilities lead and is normally limited to lab work that cannot be scheduled during the day.

Desks are not assigned. Book a desk or a lab bench up to four weeks ahead in the Spaces app; bookings that are not checked in by 10:30 are released automatically so that colleagues can use them. Team zones are reserved on Tuesdays and Thursdays so that teams can sit together on their shared hub days.

Lockers are available on a first-come, first-served basis and must be emptied every Friday evening. Long-term storage for prototypes and test rigs is available in the Rotterdam and Porto hubs on request.

Every hub has quiet rooms, bookable meeting rooms and a kitchen with free coffee, tea and fruit. Lunch is subsidised in the Porto canteen, and in Leeds and Rotterdam employees receive a meal card that is topped up for every day they badge into the hub.

Visitors must be registered in the Spaces app by their host at least one day before their visit and must be accompanied at all times in lab areas.

sources.title: Sorrelwick Retail Group - Company Cards and Claim Approval
sources.text:
Colleagues who travel or buy goods for the business regularly may be issued a Sorrelwick company card. The card must only be used for business expenses allowed under this policy. Cash withdrawals are blocked, and any personal spending on the card must be repaid within 14 days.

Every transaction on a company card must be matched to a receipt and coded in the Expenses app by the end of the following month. If a receipt is lost, complete a missing receipt declaration; more than three declarations in any 12-month period will be reviewed by Finance.

Expense claims are approved by your line manager. Managers should check that each item has a business purpose, that the correct expense category has been used and that the amount is within the limits in this policy. Claims over GBP 500 also need approval from the budget holder.

Approved claims for out-of-pocket expenses are paid with the next monthly salary, provided they are approved by the 20th of the month. Claims approved after that date are paid the following month.

Misuse of a company card or the submission of a false claim is treated as gross misconduct under the disciplinary policy.

sources.title: Sorrelwick Retail Group - Expenses Policy: Overnight Stays and Meals
sources.text:
Colleagues who need to stay away from home overnight on business should book accommodation through the Sorrelwick travel desk, which has negotiated rates with hotels near our stores and distribution centres. If the travel desk cannot find a room within the nightly limit, it may approve a higher rate in advance.

The nightly limits for a room only are GBP 140 in London and GBP 95 elsewhere in the UK. Breakfast may be added if it is not included in the room rate.

When you are away overnight, you can claim the actual cost of an evening meal up to GBP 30, including one soft drink. Lunch can be claimed up to GBP 10 when a business journey takes you more than five miles from your usual place of work between 12:00 and 14:00. Alcohol is not reimbursed.

Personal items such as newspapers, toiletries, in-room films and laundry for stays of fewer than four nights are not reimbursable.

All claims for accommodation and meals must be submitted through the Expenses app with itemised receipts. Card payment slips on their own are not accepted as receipts.

sources.text:
This section explains how Sorrelwick Retail Group reimburses colleagues who use their own vehicle for business journeys, such as travelling between stores, visiting suppliers or attending training at the Support Centre. Ordinary commuting between home and your usual place of work is not a business journey and cannot be claimed.

Mileage rates. Colleagues who use their own car for business journeys will be reimbursed at 52 pence per mile from 1 April 2026, provided the journey is recorded in the mileage log within 30 days of travel. Journeys recorded after that deadline are not reimbursed. Journeys made before 1 April 2026 are reimbursed at the previous rate of 45 pence per mile. Business journeys by motorcycle are reimbursed at 24 pence per mile and by bicycle at 20 pence per mile.

Passengers. If you carry a colleague who is also travelling on business, you can add 5 pence per mile for each passenger.

Parking and tolls. Parking charges and road tolls paid during a business journey can be claimed in addition to mileage, as long as a receipt is attached. Penalty charges, including parking fines and speeding fines, are never reimbursed.

Insurance. Before using your own vehicle for work, make sure your motor insurance covers business use. Sorrelwick does not reimburse the extra cost of business-use cover, and you may be asked to show your certificate of insurance at any time.

sources.title: Halcyra Biotech - Learning and Development Budgets
sources.text:
Halcyra Biotech wants every employee to keep learning. Each division receives an annual learning and development budget, which can be used for courses, conferences, professional certifications, books and online learning subscriptions that relate to the employee's current role or agreed development plan.

Individual budgets in Research and Development. In the Research and Development division, individual contributors have an annual learning budget of EUR 1,500 and people managers have an annual learning budget of EUR 2,100. The higher amount for managers is intended to cover leadership training in addition to scientific development.

Other divisions. Budgets for Manufacturing, Quality, Commercial and Corporate Functions are set each January by the division head and published on that division's intranet page. They are not individual allowances, so employees should agree any spending with their manager before booking.

Budgets run with the calendar year. Unused budget does not carry over to the following year and cannot be transferred to a colleague.

Approval and payment. Requests up to EUR 500 can be approved by your manager. Requests above EUR 500, and any request involving travel outside the EU, also need approval from the division's learning partner. Wherever possible, the Learning team pays the provider directly so that you do not have to claim the cost back.

If an employee leaves Halcyra within 12 months of completing a course that cost more than EUR 2,000, they may be asked to repay part of the cost, as set out in the training agreement signed before booking.

sources.title: Halcyra Biotech - Tuition Support for Degree Programmes
sources.text:
Tuition support is separate from the divisional learning and development budgets. It helps employees who want to complete a longer qualification, such as a part-time bachelor's or master's degree, a doctorate, or a chartered professional qualification that takes more than a year to complete.

Employees with at least 12 months of service and a current performance rating of 'meets expectations' or above can apply. Halcyra will cover up to 75% of tuition fees, to a maximum of EUR 6,000 per academic year, for a qualification that is relevant to the employee's career at Halcyra. Fees for resits, late registration, accommodation and travel are not covered.

Applications are reviewed twice a year, in March and September, by a panel that includes a representative from People and a senior leader from the applicant's division. The panel considers business relevance, the employee's development plan and the funding available.

Employees who receive tuition support sign an agreement that requires them to repay part of the fees if they leave Halcyra within two years of completing the qualification, or if they withdraw from the programme without good reason.

Tuition support is paid directly to the institution at the start of each academic year.

sources.title: Halcyra Biotech - Conference Attendance and Presenting
sources.text:
Attending scientific conferences is an important part of how Halcyra researchers share and learn. This page explains how attendance is organised. The cost of attending is normally paid from the relevant learning and development budget, unless you are presenting.

If you have had an abstract, poster or talk accepted, the Scientific Communications team will pay your registration fee, travel and accommodation from the central communications budget, so the trip does not reduce your learning budget. Send the acceptance letter to Scientific Communications at least six weeks before the event.

Before presenting any Halcyra data externally, you must get clearance from the Publication Review Board. The board meets every two weeks and needs the final slides or poster at least ten working days before the event.

To avoid too many colleagues attending the same event, no more than four employees from one department may attend a single conference unless a director agrees otherwise. Attendees are expected to share a short summary of what they learned with their team within a month of returning.

Travel to conferences is booked through the travel portal and follows the standard business travel policy.

sources.title: Tamberlyn Housing Association - Flexi-Time Scheme
sources.text:
Most office-based roles at Tamberlyn are part of the flexi-time scheme. Under the scheme you can choose when to start and finish work within a bandwidth of 7:30 am to 7 pm, as long as you are at work during the core hours of 10 am to 12 noon and 2 pm to 4 pm from Monday to Thursday, and 10 am to 12 noon on Fridays.

Hours are recorded in the Timesheets section of the staff portal and balanced over a four-week accounting period. You may carry a credit of up to 15 hours, or a debit of up to 7 hours, from one accounting period to the next. Any credit above 15 hours at the end of a period is lost unless your manager agreed in advance that the extra hours were needed.

With your manager's approval, you can use flexi credit to take up to two full flexi days in each accounting period. Half flexi days can be taken in the morning or the afternoon.

Neighbourhood officers, repairs operatives and contact centre staff work to rotas and are not part of the flexi-time scheme. Their working arrangements are set out in their contracts.

sources.title: Tamberlyn Housing Association - Summer Working Hours 2026
sources.text:
Tamberlyn Housing Association is running its summer working hours scheme again this year to give colleagues more time to rest during the long days of summer.

Between 5 June and 28 August 2026, employees may finish work at 1 pm on Fridays without using annual leave. Outside this period, normal working hours apply, and an early finish on a Friday must be covered by annual leave or flexi-time in the usual way.

Contracted hours do not change. Employees will be paid in full for the Friday afternoons they do not work, and they are not expected to make up the time on other days. Employees who do not normally work on a Friday do not receive an early finish on another day instead.

If an early-finish Friday falls on a day when an employee is on annual leave or off sick, it cannot be moved to another day. Teams should only arrange Friday afternoon meetings during the scheme where they are essential.

During the scheme, calls to the tenant contact centre after 1 pm on Fridays will be answered by our contracted out-of-hours service, and emergency repairs will be handled by the usual on-call contractors. Tenants were told about the change in the June newsletter.

sources.title: Tamberlyn Housing Association - Annual Leave and Bank Holidays
sources.text:
Full-time employees at Tamberlyn receive 26 days of annual leave a year, rising by one day for each complete year of service to a maximum of 31 days, plus the eight bank holidays. Part-time employees receive a pro-rata entitlement calculated in hours.

The leave year runs from 1 April to 31 March. Leave must be requested through the staff portal and approved by your manager before it is taken. Requests for more than ten consecutive working days should be made at least two months in advance.

Tamberlyn closes its offices between Christmas and New Year. Employees must keep three days of annual leave to cover the closure days that are not bank holidays; the dates are confirmed each September.

You may carry up to five days of unused leave into the next leave year. Exceptions above five days are only made where an employee has been unable to take leave because of long-term sickness or family leave.

Employees can also buy up to five additional days of leave each year through the salary sacrifice scheme, which opens for applications in February.

After each volunteering day, we encourage you to share a short note or photo on the Foundation channel so that others can find out about the organisations we support.

standalone.question: How much paid bereavement leave do Ravelstone colleagues get when a grandparent dies?
standalone.answer: Ravelstone colleagues can take up to 10 days of paid bereavement leave following the death of a grandparent.

sources.title: Ravelstone Pharmacy Group - Bereavement and Compassionate Leave
sources.text:
We know that losing someone close is one of the hardest things anyone goes through. This policy sets out the paid time off available to Ravelstone colleagues when someone close to them dies.

Paid bereavement leave. Colleagues can take up to 10 days of paid bereavement leave following the death of a spouse, civil partner, partner or child, including a stillbirth after 24 weeks of pregnancy. Colleagues can take up to 5 days of paid bereavement leave following the death of a parent, step-parent, sibling or grandparent. For the death of another relative or a close friend, colleagues can take 1 day of paid leave to attend the funeral.

The days do not have to be taken together, and they can be taken at any point within 6 months of the death, for example to attend a funeral abroad or deal with the person's estate.

Pharmacists and pharmacy technicians should let their store manager know as early as possible so that locum cover can be arranged; colleagues in the support office should tell their line manager.

Further time off. If you need more time, you can take annual leave or unpaid leave, or your manager may agree a phased return. Colleagues can also use the Employee Assistance Programme for free, confidential bereavement counselling at any time.

sources.title: Ravelstone Pharmacy Group - Time Off for Dependants
sources.text:
Colleagues are entitled to reasonable time off to deal with an unexpected situation involving a dependant, such as a child falling ill, a breakdown in childcare arrangements, or an elderly relative needing urgent help. A dependant is your spouse or partner, your child, a parent, or anyone who lives with you or relies on you for care.

The first 2 days of time off for dependants in any calendar year are paid at your normal rate. Further time off is unpaid, although you may choose to use annual leave instead.

Time off for dependants is meant for dealing with the immediate situation and arranging longer-term care, not for providing that care over a long period. In most cases one or two days will be enough. If you need more time, talk to your manager about annual leave, unpaid leave or a temporary change to your working pattern.

In stores, please call your store manager before the start of your shift, or as soon as you reasonably can. Support office colleagues should contact their line manager by phone or message. On your return, record the absence in the HR system under 'Dependant leave'.

standalone.question: When does Ottervane's office attendance requirement increase to three days a week?
standalone.answer: Ottervane’s minimum office attendance for hybrid employees increases from two to three days per week from 5 October 2026.

sources.title: Ottervane Insurance - Home-Working Equipment
sources.text:
Every Ottervane employee who works from home for part or all of the week can order a standard home-working kit through the IT self-service portal. The kit includes a monitor, a docking station, a keyboard and mouse, and a headset approved for use with our telephony system.

If you need an ergonomic chair, a sit-stand desk or other specialist equipment, complete a display screen equipment self-assessment first. Where the assessment shows a need, Occupational Health will arrange the equipment and it will be delivered to your home.

Equipment provided by Ottervane remains company property. It must be returned through the courier collection service when you leave or if you no longer work from home, and it is covered by Ottervane's insurance while it is at your home address.

You are responsible for providing a suitable home internet connection. Ottervane does not reimburse broadband or energy costs, but employees who work from home regularly may be able to claim tax relief directly from the tax authority.

Faulty equipment should be reported to the IT service desk, which will normally send a replacement within three working days.

sources.title: Ottervane Insurance - Hybrid Working: Changes to Office Attendance
sources.text:
Over the past year, many teams have told us that they get the most value from the office when they are there together. After consultation with employee representatives, we are changing our hybrid working guidance.

From 5 January 2027, the minimum office attendance for hybrid employees will increase from two to three days per week. Until then, the current minimum of two days per week continues to apply. Each team will agree its anchor days with its leadership team before the end of November 2026, so that colleagues can plan childcare and travel.

The change does not affect employees with a contractual home-working arrangement, employees with an agreed workplace adjustment, or field-based claims handlers, whose working patterns are set out in their contracts.

To support the change, we are adding bookable desks at our Exeter and Leicester offices, and the staff restaurant in Leicester will open on Fridays from January.

If you think the change will cause you particular difficulty, please talk to your manager or the People team. Requests for flexible working continue to be considered under our flexible working policy.

standalone.question: Do hybrid employees at Ardenhollow Games get a home-office stipend?
standalone.answer: Hybrid employees at Ardenhollow Games receive a one-time home-office stipend of USD 750.

sources.title: Ardenhollow Games - Remote Work Policy: Working Hours and Collaboration
sources.text:
Ardenhollow teams are spread across several time zones, so we rely on a shared collaboration window. All employees, whatever their working arrangement, are expected to be available between 16:00 and 19:00 UTC on weekdays for meetings, reviews and playtests. Outside that window, you can organise your working day in the way that suits you and your team.

Playtests and milestone reviews are scheduled at least one week ahead and recorded for colleagues who cannot attend live. Please keep your calendar up to date so that producers can see when you are available.

Fully remote employees are invited to an in-person studio week twice a year. Ardenhollow books and pays for travel and accommodation for these weeks.

We ask everyone to keep their camera on during team ceremonies such as sprint planning and retrospectives, but cameras are optional in other meetings.

If you want to change your working arrangement, for example from hybrid to fully remote, talk to your manager first and then submit a request in the HR system. Changes are normally reviewed within four weeks.

sources.title: Ardenhollow Games - Remote Work Policy: Home-Office Stipend
sources.text:
Ardenhollow Games employs people in three working arrangements: fully remote, hybrid and studio-based. Your arrangement is stated in your contract and shown on your profile in the HR system.

Home-office stipend. Fully remote employees receive a one-time home-office stipend of USD 750 to set up a safe and comfortable workspace. The stipend can be used for a desk, an ergonomic chair, a monitor, a headset, lighting or other equipment approved by IT. It is paid through payroll within the first two pay periods after your start date or after you move to a fully remote arrangement.

Hybrid and studio-based employees are not eligible for the home-office stipend, because they have an assigned desk in one of our studios. They may borrow a laptop stand, keyboard and mouse for home use from the studio IT desk.

Internet costs. Fully remote employees can also claim up to USD 50 per month toward home internet costs, with a copy of the bill.

Leaving Ardenhollow. Equipment bought with the stipend belongs to you. If you leave within six months of receiving the stipend, a pro-rata share will be deducted from your final pay.
